title: Predatory App: Repeated billing attempts after cancellation
body:
Activated Bundle Premium Jan 7 (ID Azz3aEV7bnrv310fd) and cancelled shortly afterward. Since Jan 21 the company has repeatedly attempted to charge €34.99 directly — for some other bundle added without my informed consent — to my card despite cancellation and despite the original bundle price being €25.99.

These charges are not Apple subscriptions; the merchant (FABULOUS FABULOUS SAS) is repeatedly attempting direct payment via Apple Pay. My card issuer has already flagged the attempts.

Support has been contacted. 

Revealingly, their FAQ has a section called “I have a Past Due payment or a pending invoice from Fabulous”, with abusive language such as “the cancellation will be valid at the end of the next billing (…) and the payment for the previous cycle will remain pending until collected.”

Tell me you’re a predatory vulture without telling me that you are …

If you subscribe, check billing carefully and confirm cancellation through every channel. If you are in the EU, your contracts have a 15-day grace period. Open a ticket with your card Report undue charges to your card.  

And escalate. Fabulous relies on attrition — enough clients give up, that it’s worth it for them.

title: Nice App - Horrible with Charging
body:
It’s by now the second time around I’ve been using the app, hoping this time they wouldn’t over charge me again like that… but I was wrong. 

This year I was applying g for the service and as it is a process of trust building app - it’s important to be able to progress and receive access to the next steps - I found out after two weeks of progress that they asked me to pay again for the premium - and I could not progress for a few days - then signed up again - then it charged me twice (what?) 

Then talked to them about canceling the payment - then after a charge for an ENTIRE YEAR - the received my double payment and just stopped my premium membership after less than two months. Then I wrote to them and they made it complicated to write to them about it - a person was actually recievi g the message but they asked to sign up in another way - but this time not in the app - but onine and … gosh so complicated and frustrating! 

It’s been like this similar with annual charges and complicated cancelations from a few years ago that it slipped through my notice that they were charging me far after I stopped using and not having an easy way to stop the membership - after I also wrote them emails about asking to stop the service 

In other words - they have your card - be exprlected to get charged until they decide to listen to you again. 

Of course after telling them that they don’t bother to check or offer amends for the money you’ve paid… 

Nice app - don’t like to check my phone to get motivated and focused (you know other things pop up) but really improve your customer service guys..

title: Be careful. App will sneakily charge you
body:
This app claims you have a feee trial period but you don’t. When you sign the trial they automatically signed you for a big period (in my case a year for 69.99). I went immediately to my subscription to cancel, but it will only stop the subscription one year after. You can’t stop the subscription during the trial. As soon as you’re charged, apple will not refund you this subscription, so you’re tied for paying one year, even though you were lead to believe you were signing in for a trial. It’s deceptive and even close to a scam. Be very very careful if you download.

They will defend themselves to every bad critic saying you can go to settings and cancel during the trial but you can’t. You sign up for one year and apple doesn’t refund you it you try to cancel it.

Everywhere all over the web you will find the same critic, but Apple seems to fail to address the problem.
